content.title: How to watch Dodgers vs. Blue Jays: TV channel and streaming options for April 7
content.text: Shohei Ohtani brings a two-game homer streak into the Los Angeles Dodgers’ game against the Toronto Blue Jays at 7:07 p.m. ET on Tuesday, at Rogers Centre. Yoshinobu Yamamoto (1-1, 3.00 ERA) gets the start for the Dodgers, who are 8-2 this season and first in the NL West.
